grammar.pattern: numbers · 二 / 两 · 十 / 百 · 半
grammar.explanation: 零、一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九 name digits. 十 starts the tens: 十一, 二十; 百 starts hundreds: 一百. Use 二 in 二十 and room numbers; use 两 before ordinary classifiers: 两个鸡蛋. 半 means half: 半杯奶. Read 元 as formal yuan, 块 as everyday yuan, and 毛 as one tenth of a yuan. Citation pinyin keeps 一 as yī; its spoken tone changes before following tones.

commonMistakes.why: Use 二 rather than 两 in 二十.

grammar.explanation: A quantity phrase combines a number with a classifier, usually followed by the noun: 三个鸡蛋, 两杯水. When the object is already understood, the noun can be omitted: 我要两个. 半 precedes the classifier. Some amounts name a portion rather than an object: 半杯奶 is a measured amount of milk.

lines.zh: 今天谁来做午饭？
lines.py: jīn tiān shéi lái zuò wǔ fàn ?
lines.en: Who is making lunch today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我们一起做。我有半天时间。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ zuò . wǒ yǒu bàn tiān shí jiān .
lines.en: We will make it together. I have half a day.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 早饭吃了吗？
lines.py: zǎo fàn chī le ma ?
lines.en: Have you had breakfast?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 吃了面包，喝了半杯奶。
lines.py: chī le miàn bāo , hē le bàn bēi nǎi .
lines.en: I had bread and half a cup of milk.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我去买一些菜，你买肉，好吗？
lines.py: wǒ qù mǎi yī xiē cài , nǐ mǎi ròu , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: I will buy some vegetables. Could you buy meat?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。鸡蛋买几个？
lines.py: hǎo . jī dàn mǎi jǐ gè ?
lines.en: Okay. How many eggs shall we buy?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 买六个，我们每个人吃两个。
lines.py: mǎi liù gè , wǒ men měi gè rén chī liǎng gè .
lines.en: Buy six. Each of us will eat two.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我的钱不多，六个鸡蛋多少钱？
lines.py: wǒ de qián bù duō , liù gè jī dàn duō shao qián ?
lines.en: I do not have much money. How much are six eggs?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 一共六元。包子两块五毛一个。
lines.py: yī gòng liù yuán . bāo zi liǎng kuài wǔ máo yī gè .
lines.en: Six yuan altogether. The steamed buns are two yuan fifty each.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 肉是不是太少了？
lines.py: ròu shì bú shì tài shǎo le ?
lines.en: Is there too little meat?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 午饭吃一半，晚饭吃一半。我准备米饭和水。
lines.py: wǔ fàn chī yí bàn , wǎn fàn chī yí bàn . wǒ zhǔn bèi mǐ fàn hé shuǐ .
lines.en: Half is for lunch and half for dinner. I will prepare rice and water.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。你做的菜很好吃。
lines.py: xíng . nǐ zuò de cài hěn hǎo chī .
lines.en: Okay. The dishes you make are tasty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天我们一起做午饭和晚饭。

lines.zh: 鸡蛋一共六元，包子两块五毛一个。

lines.py: wǒ zhǔn bèi sān bēi shuǐ , yě zhǔn bèi yī xiē nǎi .

lines.zh: 我早饭只喝了半杯奶，现在想喝水。
lines.py: wǒ zǎo fàn zhǐ hē le bàn bēi nǎi , xiàn zài xiǎng hē shuǐ .

lines.zh: 米饭不少，肉也不少。
lines.py: mǐ fàn bù shǎo , ròu yě bù shǎo .

lines.zh: 你做的菜很好吃，我们都想再吃。
lines.py: nǐ zuò de cài hěn hǎo chī , wǒ men dōu xiǎng zài chī .
lines.en: Your dishes are tasty. We would all like some more.
